metadata.description: Hardware reference and firmware-development skills for M5Stack Controllers and the Espressif SoCs they're built on.

plugins.name: cardputer
plugins.description: M5Stack Cardputer family hardware reference — pinout, peripherals, and Arduino/PlatformIO/ESP-IDF/UIFlow2 setup. Covers Cardputer Adv and the Cap LoRa-1262 (SX1262 + ATGM336H GNSS) accessory.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: M5Stack Core-family Controller hardware references — Core2 (incl. Core2 For AWS) and Tab5.

plugins.name: esp32-chips
plugins.description: Chip-level ESP-IDF capability references for the Espressif SoCs M5Stack boards are built on: classic ESP32, ESP32-S3, ESP32-C6, ESP32-P4. Board skills point into these for peripheral, sleep, memory, and radio depth.
